title: Smooth morphisms of algebraic stacks by smooth scheme presentations
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use the fibred groupoids, maps and $2$-isomorphisms of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. For a morphism $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ of algebraic stacks over $S$ [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], say that $f$ is smooth if there exist $S$-schemes $U,V$, a smooth surjective scheme atlas $a:U\to\mathcal X$, a representable smooth map $b:V\to\mathcal Y$, and a smooth scheme morphism $q:U\to V$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], together with a $2$-isomorphism $fa\cong bq$. Representable smoothness of $b$ means the source-local algebraic-space scheme test of [def-sfb-dm-stack-morphism-properties] with the property smooth. No surjectivity of $b$, no representability of $f$, and no choice of a chart is part of the predicate.
